note: Portfolio alerts, /pnl and /buy. Alerts cover the WHOLE wallet (every priceable ERC-20 on Ethereum and Base, not just baskets) and are built around restraint: a move must clear both a percentage and a dollar floor, at most a few a day, never twice about one asset within 12h, always ending in something actionable, /alerts off honoured immediately. /pnl measures from the moment you linked and says so. /buy prices an order and opens the venue — the bot never signs.
